title: Build Manifest Schema
description: Schema for per-module build manifests stored at out/build/<module>/.manifest.json. Each manifest is immutable after creation and represents the contract for what artifacts a specific build produced.

build_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the module was built

git_commit.description: Git commit SHA (40 hex characters) at build time

requested_artifacts.description: List of artifact IDs that were requested to be built

artifacts.description: Artifacts actually produced by the build

platforms.description: Platforms this module was built for

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of all module source files at build time. Used to validate CI cache hits by comparing current source hash to cached artifact hash.

verified_unchanged_at.description: Git SHA when the builder last verified this module was unchanged and didn't need rebuilding. This is the only field that can be updated after initial manifest creation.

artifact_info.description: Information about a single built artifact

id.description: Artifact identifier as defined in module type

path.description: Relative path from repository root to the artifact

platform.description: Platform identifier (e.g., windows-amd64, linux-arm64) if applicable

size.description: File size in bytes for file-based artifacts

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of artifact content for integrity verification

platform_info.description: Platform that was targeted by the build
